name: harp
description: Jewelbox 24 Orchestral Harp: the gilt carved harp neck is the striker; below it a concert harp in side elevation - fluted gold column with a crown on the left, maple soundboard slanting down to the gilt base with pedals, and a fan of strings (red C strings, blue F strings, the rest cream) from the neck to the soundboard.

contact.note: marble centre at hit = point + normal*R
